stage0001b_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That robot...!
　Did the spacequake bring it here...!?」

stage0001b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank goodness, you're awake.
　You were out cold for a little while.」

stage0001b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$n
「I know... I can feel it...
　It's coming...」

stage0001b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$n
「...Climb aboard and it even changes
　my clothes for me. How considerate...」

stage0001b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A robot...!?
　Did that come through the quake too!?」

stage0001b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$l...
　It looked like that robot
　pulled him inside...」

stage0001b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$n
「It poured out of that black mass,
　straight into my head...」

stage0001b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$n
「I know it...
　Its name... how to move it,
　how to fight with it!」

stage0001b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「Here we go...!
　I don't know what you are,
　but you're going to lend me your strength!」

stage0001b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$n
「Go, $$ジェニオン$$!
　Show me what you can do!!」

stage0001b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Looks like the quake threw it here...」

stage0001b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$恭子$$
「This is what you get for saying
　you wanted some excitement...」

stage0001b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All of you!
　Get to shelter, now!」

stage0001b_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$恭子$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$!
　What are those things!?」

stage0001b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The blue one looks like it's
　protecting the city. Is it a
　Federation machine!?」

stage0001b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know either...!
　Whatever it is, we run. Now!」

stage0001b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't know...!
　I've never seen either of them!」

stage0001b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Forget that for now. We have to do
　something about that bat robot!」

stage0001b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No idea what it is, but it's
　defending the city, so I don't think
　it's one of the bad guys.」

stage0001b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ワッ太$$!
　Leave this side to me. Look after
　$$マッキー$$ and $$かおる$$!」

stage0001b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「OK!
　Counting on you, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0001b_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Pilot of the blue robot,
　can you hear me?」

stage0001b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「This is $$鉄人$$ 28, of the 《$$ＩＣＰＯ$$》!
　Let's work together and
　protect the city!」

stage0001b_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Those things...!
　They mean to surround us!」

stage0001b_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$n
「They know the basics of a hunt...!」

stage0001b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But at this rate the whole city
　becomes a battlefield!」

stage0001b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What...!
　A machine appeared out of nowhere!」

stage0001b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$n
「An AS...?
　But I've never seen a model like that.」

stage0001b_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$マオ$$
「Can you hear me, boy detective of
　the $$ＩＣＰＯ$$, and mystery robot pilot?」

stage0001b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Mmm, let's say allies of justice
　who happened to be passing through.」

stage0001b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マオ$$
「And since we've said as much, we'll
　handle the Unknowns close to us.」

stage0001b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$クルツ$$
「There she is, the pure and righteous
　genuine ally of justice! So obliging.」

stage0001b_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$宗介$$
「There's no time for chatter, $$クルツ$$.」

stage0001b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$宗介$$'s right. Having made a show
　of it, we're not allowed to betray
　that kid's trust.」

stage0001b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$マオ$$
「And above all, we have
　a mission to carry out.」

stage0001b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$ウルズ$$ 2 to 6 and 7!
　7 and I take point!
　6, cover us from the rear!」

stage0001b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well then, let's get to it!」

stage0001b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$マオ$$
「I want data on the Unknowns.
　$$クルツ$$ and I will recover wreckage
　and pull back.」

stage0001b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$マオ$$
「You continue the mission.
　In all this confusion some troublesome
　people might go after the Angel.」

stage0001b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Right, the rest is yours.
　Don't let the boy detective catch you.」

stage0001b_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll engage $$ＥＣＳ$$ as well
　and shake off pursuit.」

stage0001b_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「An AS I've never seen...
　Who were those people...」

stage0001b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Please wait!
　Who exactly are you...」

stage0001b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「I can't let anyone else
　get hold of this...」

stage0001b_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「He and the AS pilots both
　helped us out, so I can't believe
　they're bad people, but...」

stage0001b_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「For now, finding out what that
　enemy really is comes first...」

stage0001b_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
???
「I followed the $$デイモーン$$ that activated
　on its own, and got to see
　something interesting.」

stage0001b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
???
「This planet's fighting strength...
　Not enough to call a threat after all.」

stage0001b_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
???
「...Savour your peace while you can,
　little pets. What waits for you is...」

stage0001b_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$n
「I can do this...!
　With this power, I'm sure I can...!」

stage0001b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$n
「Is it no good...!
　Do I end without doing anything!?」

stage0001b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$...
　I don't care what you are.
　I need you.」

stage0001b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$n
「So let me put it to the test!
　That power of yours!」

stage0001b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$n
「I'll fight...!
　No matter what stands there!」

stage0001b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$正太郎$$
「A new Earth Federation was formed,
　and I thought the world had
　finally found peace...!」

stage0001b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If you would disturb that peace,
　then $$鉄人$$ and I will face you!」

stage0001b_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$マオ$$
「《$$ＥＣＳ$$》 running fine...!
　That's our surprise attack ready!」

stage0001b_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Still, curiosity killed the cat...
　Never expected trouble this far
　outside the plan mid-mission.」

stage0001b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't tell me these things are
　after the Angel too...!」

stage0001b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Unknown or not, it makes no
　difference. They're targets to me...!」

stage0001b_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You lot get to play the part of
　my accumulated frustration!」

stage0001b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are these the troublesome enemies
　the Major mentioned, the ones
　after $$千鳥かなめ$$...?」

stage0001b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$宗介$$
「...No need to pry further.
　I simply carry out the mission.」
